The '''D'qell sisters''' were [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Togorian/Legends|Togorian]] sisters, who were [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]]-duelists famous during the [[Old Republic era]]. In [[3963 BBY]] they participated in the duels on [[Jervo's World]] above [[Pantolomin/Legends|Pantolomin]], where they both flew on [[Mosgoth]]s.
